title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,' new unredacted filings reveal | TechCrunch
summary: The filings show that when OpenAI researcher Nick Ryder told Brockman about a “hack to get around nytimes paywall,” Brockman replied: “ah nice.” OpenAI employees also allegedly built training datasets like WebText and WebText2 that disproportionately relied on scraped news content.
